articles.title: Europe Says 'No Way!' to Selling the World Cup to Private Investors
articles.summary: Imagine if your favorite playground got sold to a company! That's what European soccer bosses say Fifa is trying to do with the World Cup. All 55 European teams voted to boycott if the plan goes ahead.

articles.title: Veterans Wanted: Drive Big Rigs as Immigrant Truckers Lose Licenses
articles.summary: The U.S. government has a new plan: train veterans to be truck drivers. This comes after about 26,000 immigrant drivers were taken off the road for not speaking English well enough. The program lets some vets skip the driving test.

articles.title: Why Owning a Home Feels Like a Dream for Many Young People
articles.summary: The gap between renters and homeowners is bigger than ever. A new report shows home prices hit $440,600, and 77% of listings are too pricey for middle-income earners. Meet Jay, 38, who worries he may never own a home.
